episodeTitle.en: How to be the best coach to product people | Petra Wille (Strong Product People)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何成为产品团队最佳教练 | 佩特拉·威尔（Petra Wille，Strong Product People）

guestBioOfficial.en: Petra Wille is an independent product leadership coach who’s been helping product teams expand their skill sets since 2013. She’s also the author of Strong Product People, which she published in 2021. Alongside her freelance work, Petra curates and co-organizes Mind The Product Engage Hamburg. She started her career as a software developer and in 2008 went to work at Xing, a German social media site, where she learned from two incredible product leaders: Marty Cagan and Jason Goldberg. In today’s podcast, we talk about Petra’s book, and how to help your team grow as a product leader. Petra also shares how to improve your storytelling skills, get better at public speaking, and why community is so important for product managers.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 佩特拉·威尔（Petra Wille）是一位独立产品领导力教练，自2013年起就致力于帮助产品团队提升技能。她还在2021年出版了《强势产品人》一书。除自由职业外，佩特拉还策划并联合组织了Mind The Product Engage Hamburg活动。她职业生涯始于软件开发工程师，2008年加入德国社交媒体网站Xing，在那里她向两位杰出的产品领导者——马蒂·卡根（Marty Cagan）和杰森·戈德伯格（Jason Goldberg）学习。在本期播客中，我们探讨佩特拉的著作，以及如何帮助团队成长为产品领导者。佩特拉还分享如何提升讲故事技巧、提高公开演讲能力，以及为什么社区对产品经理如此重要。

title.en: How to be the best coach to product people | Petra Wille (Strong Product People)
title.zh: 如何成为产品团队最佳教练 | 佩特拉·威尔（Petra Wille，Strong Product People）

summary.en: Petra explains why coaching - not just managing - is the key skill for new product managers and leaders, and how to do it well. She makes the case that storytelling is essential for getting promoted and rallying teams, and that finding a PM community is one of the highest-leverage moves for growth. Drawing on coaching hundreds of product leaders, she offers concrete ways to develop the 'eight-legged' skill set a modern product person needs.
summary.zh: Petra 解释了为什么“辅导（coaching）”而非仅仅是管理，是新任产品经理与领导者的关键能力，以及该如何做好它。她论证了讲故事对于升职和凝聚团队至关重要，而找到一个产品经理社群则是成长中性价比最高的动作之一。基于辅导数百位产品领导者的经验，她给出了培养现代产品人所需的“八足”技能组合的具体方法。
